review_candidates.title: Executive Assistant
review_candidates.description: About Us Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces. Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected. About The Role As Executive Assistant at Harmattan AI, you will serve as a trusted right-hand partner to our founders, ensuring seamless coordination across his priorities, stakeholders, and strategic initiatives. You will be embedded at the heart of a founder-led environment operating at the intersection of advanced technology and national security — where the pace is relentless, discretion is paramount, and your impact is direct. The C-Suite operates across multiple time zones, engaging daily with government officials, investors, and senior defense stakeholders. This role demands a resilient, solutions-oriented individual who can anticipate needs, act with precision, and communicate with confidence at the highest levels. Responsibilities Executive Support Provide senior-level, strategic EA support across all business and personal priorities Manage a highly complex and evolving international calendar with strong prioritisation and proactive anticipation Act as a professional gatekeeper and communication filter, managing inbound requests with sound judgment Prepare briefing materials and ensure preparedness for all engagements Track actions and ensure consistent follow-through across key initiatives Stakeholder & Communications Management Coordinate interactions with senior stakeholders, including government, investors, and strategic partners Draft and manage high-quality communications in both French and English Build and maintain strong relationships across internal and external networks Operations & Logistics Manage complex international travel planning and logistics Act as a central point of coordination across business and leadership activities Support ad hoc projects linked to strategic and operational priorities Maintain organisation, structure, and efficiency within a fast-moving environment Candidate Requirements At least 5–10 years of proven experience supporting in a high-performance environment (private equity, private office, or equivalent) Fully bilingual in French and English, with exceptional written and verbal communication skills Strong track record of operating in fast-paced, international, high-pressure settings Outstanding technical capability and confidence using modern productivity tools, including AI Demonstrable ability to manage complexity with precision and sound judgment High levels of discretion, professionalism, and emotional intelligence Highly organised, detail-oriented, and naturally proactive Calm, solutions-driven mindset with the ability to anticipate needs before they arise Comfortable working on-site in Paris with flexibility across working hours and time zones Eligibility to work in France; security clearance requirements may apply given the nature of the organisation Excellent, verifiable references We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

review_candidates.title: Enterprise Account Executive
review_candidates.description: THE SPONSOR Bloom Equity Partners is leveraging decades of investing and operating experience to rapidly unlock transformational growth and deliver superior returns to its investment partners and management teams. Investing exclusively in lower-middle-market technology, software, and tech-enabled business service companies, Bloom drives enduring market value by partnering closely with founders and management teams – injecting capital to unlock growth and providing the operational resources and expertise needed to enable meaningful step-change in the business. The Company RightCrowd is a dynamic, rapidly expanding company in the Physical Identity and Access Management (PIAM) industry, delivering cutting-edge solutions that enhance security and streamline access control processes for a diverse range of enterprise clients. As we continue to grow and strengthen our presence in the market, we are seeking an experienced, forward-thinking, and strategic Enterprise Account Executive to join our team and play a pivotal role in winning net-new logos across the Midwest region. As an Enterprise Account Executive, you will identify, pursue, and close new sales opportunities at the enterprise level – working closely with industry channel partners to build understanding and generate enterprise sales. Duties & Responsibilities To be successful in this position, you will be expected to carry out the following duties and responsibilities: Business Development Generate new business opportunities and drive pipeline growth. Identify and target enterprise-level clients within Europe and the Middle East. Conduct thorough market research to understand prospects’ needs, challenges, and the competitive landscape. Proactively engage prospects through multiple channels, including calling, networking events, email campaigns, and social media. Understand and explore new markets and verticals. Partner with marketing and management to design campaigns that capitalize on new opportunities. Establish and foster strong relationships with prospects’ key stakeholders, including C-level executives, department heads, and procurement teams. Conduct consultative sales conversations that effectively communicate the value proposition of RightCrowd’s software solutions. Develop a deep understanding of each prospect’s business objectives, organizational structure, and decision-making processes. Collaborate with partners and prospects to understand their specific requirements and tailor proposals to address their unique needs. Sales Process Management Manage the entire sales cycle, from lead generation through commericals closure. Prepare and deliver persuasive sales proposals and negotiate contracts to achieve mutually beneficial agreements. Conduct product demonstrations and presentations that showcase the features and benefits of RightCrowd’s solutions. Utilize the CRM system and other sales tools to accurately track leads, opportunities, and sales activities. Structure multi-year agreements with clients to provide budget and price protection. Collaborate cross-functionally with internal teams to ensure customer satisfaction and alignment with market demands. Sales Performance & Metrics Meet and exceed assigned sales quotas and revenue targets driven by new logo acqusition. Develop and implement effective sales strategies and tactics to maximize performance. Continuously monitor industry trends, competitors, and market conditions to identify opportunities for growth. Provide regular, accurate sales forecasts, reports, and updates to the sales management team. Requirements To be successful in this position, you will need the following skills and experience: Several years of experience working within the security technology industry. Experience selling physical security or cybersecurity software to enterprise clients. Experience working with multi-national and regional Security Integrators and resellers. A proven track record of exceeding sales quotas and driving results. A deep competitive spirit and hunger to win. Powered by JazzHR fwNLrNvp1e

review_candidates.title: Engineering Manager (Remote)
review_candidates.job_function: Information Technology, Project Management, and Management
review_candidates.description: Role : Engineering Manager (Remote) Location : Remote (Work from Anywhere) Job Type : Full-Time Payout : Competitive, based on experience Role Overview: We are hiring for one of our clients, seeking an Engineering Manager to lead the development of high-quality, foundational large language models through supervised fine tuning and reinforcement learning from human feedback tasks. Key Responsibilities: • Lead and manage teams of 20+ Python, JavaScript, Java, and other language developers to execute technical tasks effectively. • Collaborate closely with researcher clients to ensure satisfaction with delivered work. • Maintain rigorous review processes to ensure the highest quality of datasets. • Oversee project transitions from initiation to stable states, taking full responsibility for delivery. • Identify and implement measures to enhance the quality of code within the team. Required Skills & Qualifications: • 8+ years of professional software engineering experience, including 3+ years in an engineering management role. • Proven experience managing large technical teams in a delivery-oriented role. • Experience with Python or Java and JavaScript. • Demonstrated ability to engage in hands-on technical work, identifying and resolving quality issues. • Excellent leadership and people management skills, with a focus on motivating teams. More About the Opportunity: This role offers a unique opportunity to work with a global leader in the Technology, Information and Internet industry, contributing to the transformation of AI systems from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with measurable impact. Equal Opportunity Employer: We hire based on skills and expertise. All qualified candidates are welcome regardless of background, experience, or prior employment history. Applications are reviewed solely on demonstrated technical ability and qualifications. Apply Now!

review_candidates.title: EU Field Operations Executive
review_candidates.description: About Us Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces. Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected. About The Role We are hiring a Field Operations Executive to execute demonstrations, deployments, and field operations in support of customer engagements. Reporting to an Engagement Manager, you will be responsible for operating our systems in real-world environments, ensuring readiness, customer deployments. This is a highly operational, field-first role, requiring strong technical grounding, autonomy, and execution under real-world constraints. Responsibilities Field Execution Execute technical demonstrations, tests, and deployments in operational environments Operate UAV systems, payloads, and software during customer demos and trials Ensure systems are mission-ready, calibrated, and fully functional before deployment System Operation & Troubleshooting Monitor system performance in real time and troubleshoot issues in the field Identify and resolve hardware, software, and integration issues under time constraints Support integration and validation of systems in customer or partner environments Preparation & Logistics Prepare and configure demo kits, hardware, and software stacks Manage field logistics, including transport, setup, and teardown of systems Ensure compliance with operational and safety procedures Data & Feedback Collect and structure field data, logs, and observations Support post-mission analysis (flight logs, system performance, anomalies) Provide clear and actionable feedback to Engagement, Product, and Engineering teams Continuous Improvement Contribute to improving demo workflows, operational processes, and field playbooks Support the standardization of tools and procedures for repeatable, high-quality deployments Candidate Requirements Experience in field operations, testing, or deployment of UAVs, robotics, or complex technical systems Strong hands-on ability with hardware + software systems Comfortable operating in real-world, sometimes constrained environments Proven ability to troubleshoot technical issues under pressure Adaptability & Mobility: Thrives under pressure in a fast-paced, dynamic environment; embraces a “no-task-is-too-small” mentality. Communication & Influence: Excellent written and verbal communication, capable of leading diverse principals – from junior members to senior executives. Commitment: 100% dedication to Harmattan AI’s mission, vision, and ambitious growth plans, ready to go the extra mile to ensure operational excellence. UAV pilot license strongly preferred High willingness to travel (significant field presence required) We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

review_candidates.title: ERP Implementation Specialist (Full-Time, Mid-Level)
review_candidates.description: About the role This is a full-time, permanent position focused on implementing, supporting, and optimizing enterprise ERP systems for clients, with an emphasis on supply chain, manufacturing, and planning modules. This is a client-facing role first . You’ll work directly with clients to understand their needs, solve problems, and help them get the most out of their ERP environment. Strong functional expertise is important, but so is the ability to communicate clearly, build trust, and navigate conversations with both business and executive stakeholders. Required skills: Client communication: You’re comfortable leading status calls, presenting findings, discussing recommendations, and managing escalations with professionalism and composure. You can communicate confidently with clients while keeping conversations focused and productive. Technical communication: You’re able to take technical concepts such as configurations, integrations, and system behavior and explain them in clear, straightforward language that makes sense to business and executive audiences. Consulting / IT services experience: You’ve built your career within an IT services company, systems integrator, ERP vendor, or consulting firm (e.g., Accenture, NTT Data, Wipro, Infosys, or an ERP-partner boutique). This experience is required. Candidates whose ERP experience has been exclusively in-house at a single employer will not be a fit for this role. Enterprise ERP experience: 5–8 years of experience working with a major enterprise ERP platform such as Oracle, SAP, Workday, Dynamics, or NetSuite. Implementation experience: At least one full-cycle ERP implementation, with hands-on involvement across requirements, configuration, testing, cutover, and post-go-live support. Functional expertise: Strong functional knowledge in SCM-adjacent areas such as inventory, order management, procurement, costing, or planning. Integration experience: Familiarity with REST/SOAP APIs, third-party system connections, and data migration, with an understanding of how ERP systems connect with the broader technology environment. Written communication: You can produce clear, useful documentation, status reports, and issue summaries that help nontechnical stakeholders understand what’s happening and what needs to happen next. Preferred skills: Experience presenting to steering committees, executive sponsors, or client leadership Experience working across multiple industries and client environments Experience automating support or testing workflows Familiarity with reporting and analytics tools, including BI and embedded ERP analytics

review_candidates.title: Distributor Manager - Channel Excellence (MedTech)
review_candidates.description: The Company Dexcom Corporation (NASDAQ DXCM) is a pioneer and global leader in continuous glucose monitoring (CGM). Dexcom began as a small company with a big dream: To forever change how diabetes is managed. To unlock information and insights that drive better health outcomes. Here we are 25 years later, having pioneered an industry. And we're just getting started. We are broadening our vision beyond diabetes to empower people to take control of health. That means personalized, actionable insights aimed at solving important health challenges. To continue what we've started: Improving human health. We are driven by thousands of ambitious, passionate people worldwide who are willing to fight like warriors to earn the trust of our customers by listening, serving with integrity, thinking big, and being dependable. We've already changed millions of lives and we're ready to change millions more. Our future ambition is to become a leading consumer health technology company while continuing to develop solutions for serious health conditions. We'll get there by constantly reinventing unique biosensing-technology experiences. Though we've come a long way from our small company days, our dreams are bigger than ever. The opportunity to improve health on a global scale stands before us. Meet The Team Strategy, Partnerships & Growth Enablement is the EMEA function where EMEA's next chapter gets built. Our region is moving from selling great technology to leading on outcomes — helping people act earlier, helping clinicians decide better, and helping health systems get more value. Channel is how that intent reaches real patients, at scale. As Distributor Manager - Channel Excellence EMEA , you'll help drive and stand up our Channel Excellence Centre of Excellence from a blank page: setting the standard for how we partner, where we grow, and what "great" looks like across markets. Expect real ownership, senior visibility, and a region with a genuine runway ahead of it. If you like building things that don't exist yet — with a team that pushes thinking, moves fast, stays focused on impact and cares about the patient at the end of it — you'll fit right in. Role Summary Distributor Manager - Channel Excellence EMEA is an execution-focused role responsible for translating agreed channel priorities into scalable governance, operational processes, distributor management routines, and performance visibility across EMEA. The role manages channel performance, removes operational friction, and supports country teams through practical tools, structured governance, and disciplined follow-up. It contributes across the distributor lifecycle, from identification and onboarding through governance, KPI management, performance improvement, and portfolio evolution. This role reports to the Director, Market Development and Business Integration EMEA and partners closely with Business leaders, Marketing, Market Access, Finance, Legal, Analytics, and country teams. The role supports strategic decision-making through structured analysis and recommendations but does not own final strategic channel decisions. Where You Come In You will translate agreed EMEA channel priorities into practical operating processes, governance routines, partner management tools, and market-level execution plans. You manage the operational governance for distributor identification, evaluation, scoring, onboarding, and approval readiness across direct and indirect markets. You design and maintain scalable playbooks, onboarding checklists, templates, governance calendars, and digital tools that enable consistent partner management. You partner with Marketing, Market Access, Finance, Legal, Analytics, and country teams to remove execution barriers and support distributor activation. You track channel performance, distributor capability, contract adherence, trade compliance metrics, action items, and improvement plans through structured KPI visibility. You are responsible for coordinating issue tracking, escalation paths, compliance handoffs, training needs, systems access, and service-level expectations. You provide commercially grounded analysis and recommendations to support distributor portfolio evolution, including expansion, consolidation, replacement, or exit considerations. What Makes You Successful You bring strong channel management, distributor governance, commercial operations, or partner management capability in a regional or multi-market environment. You can convert strategic priorities into clear operating processes, implementation tools, governance routines, and measurable execution plans. You are confident working across matrixed teams and influencing without authority across Commercial, Finance, Legal, Analytics, Market Access, Marketing, and country stakeholders. You manage complexity well, balancing partner performance, compliance requirements, operational readiness, and market-specific needs across diverse EMEA channel models. You know which KPIs are important, how to interpret and to distill out meaningful insights. You are a proficient communicator of KPI derived insights enabling business decisions to be taken in a timely and impactful manner. You have strong communication, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to create structure where processes are evolving or ambiguous. You bring attention to detail and sound commercial judgement when assessing distributor capability, operational maturity, compliance readiness, and strategic fit. Your experience in medical technology, healthcare, pharmacy, retail, distributor, or indirect-market environments is an advantage. What You’ll Get A front row seat to life changing CGM technology. Learn about our brave #dexcomwarriors community. A full and comprehensive benefits program. Growth opportunities on a global scale. Access to career development through in-house learning programs and/or qualified tuition reimbursement. An exciting and innovative, industry-leading organization committed to our employees, customers, and the communities we serve. Travel Required 25 to 50% Experience And Education Requirements Typically requires a Bachelor’s degree and a minimum of 8-12 years of related experience. At this level a graduate degree may be desirable with 4 years of related experience Flex Workplace: Your primary location will be a home office. You will not have an assigned workstation and will work with your manager to determine office visit needs. You must live within commuting distance of your assigned Dexcom site (typically 75 miles/120km). To all Staffing and Recruiting Agencies: Our Careers Site is only for individuals seeking a job at Dexcom. Only authorized staffing and recruiting agencies may use this site or to submit profiles, applications or resumes on specific requisitions. review_candidates.description: Job Description ABOUT EDGE At EDGE bold ideas are engineered into technologies that protect, improve and save lives. Headquartered in the United Arab Emirates, EDGE is a leading advanced technology group working at the forefront of defence and emerging technologies. Spanning more than 35 specialised companies and multiple centres of excellence, we are purpose-built to move fast. Free from heavy legacy processes, we give our people the autonomy, accountability, and agility to bring breakthrough technologies from concept to reality. Based in Abu Dhabi, a globally connected hub at the crossroads of Europe, Asia, Africa, and the Middle East, EDGE is home to a truly multicultural community where bold ideas thrive, and the future is shaped. Together, we are shaping the future. About The Role About POWERTECH POWERTECH is a center of excellence for propulsion technologies, specializing in the design, engineering, and manufacturing of combustion engines, expendable turbojet engines, and turbofan engines for a wide range of aerospace, defence, and autonomous applications, including fixed- and rotary-wing UAVs and other advanced platforms. Purpose The CRC Senior Engineer is accountable for ensuring end-to-end consistency, clarity and traceability of contractual commitments and customer requirements, supporting the product road map deployment and lifecycle of the turbofan propulsion systems throughout the full lifecycle (from pre-contract phase to program execution and in-service support/MRO). The role ensures that market needs, customer expectations and platform integration requirements are translated into clear product objectives, priorities and development pathway. Acting as the voice of customer and 1st rank partners, he acts as a primary interface with platform customer and OEM partners. Responsibilities Supports contract establishment and negotiation with customers and OEM partners Translates contractual clauses into actionable requirements, ensuring alignment with technical scope, commercial commitments and delivery obligations Monitor contract compliance throughout the program lifecycle and associated contracts: pre-development, development, joint-venture if any, main suppliers or related departments (Advanced Manufacturing, Supply Chain), Capability Building and Transfer of Technology if any. On behalf of Powertech, support the coordination and organization of the activities critically at the interfaces between the OEM partners and Platform Customers (team/skills, tools and process of information exchange, risks management etc…). Define and manage these interfaces, in collaboration with Turbofan and Powertech departments. Reinforce the position of Powertech, clarify ambiguities and resolve conflicts. Coordinate workshops and reviews. Capture and consolidate customer requirements and mission needs, translating them into product specifications and technical/engineering requirements in close interaction with System Engineering Lead, EDGE commercial line and Industrial Lead. Ensures consistency and completeness of requirements baseline. Ensure full traceability from requirements to verification. Monitor compliance with contractual requirements, regulatory standards, and internal quality processes. Basic Qualifications Minimum 10 years of experience within turbofan propulsion, aerospace, or other complex engineered systems. Solid understanding of turbofan architectures (turbofan, modules, sub-systems and their integration constraints), performance drivers and technology road maps Experience in program management, program leadership, system approach. Exposure to customer, OEMs, authorities, or large-scale development programs Knowledge of V&V, airworthiness and certification frameworks (such as FAA Part 33, 21, CS-E, CS-25, …) Preferred Qualifications High customer orientation and business mindset Strong product vision understanding and relationship/contract management. Ability to analyze and structure complex information into actionable decision under pressure with a sense of urgency Ability to work in a multicultural environment, across engineering, manufacturing, MRO, supply chain and commercial teams. Excellent communication, influencing, and stakeholder management skills WHY CHOOSE EDGE Launched in November 2019, the UAEs EDGE is one of the worlds leading advanced technology groups, established to develop agile, bold and disruptive solutions for defence and beyond, and to be a catalyst for change and transformation. It is dedicated to bringing breakthrough innovations, products, and services to market with greater speed and efficiency, to position the UAE as a leading global hub for future industries, and to creating clear paths within the sector for the next generation of highly skilled talent to thrive. At EDGE, the real investment goes beyond compensation. Through our dedicated learning academy and digital learning platforms, employees have access to extensive opportunities to develop new skills, deepen their expertise, and advance their careers. Combined with the freedom to innovate, strong career support, and the opportunity to collaborate with world-class talent from across the globe, EDGE is a place where you can continue to grow, keep learning, and turn ambitious ideas into meaningful outcomes. Working at EDGE also comes with a package that genuinely reflects how much we value our people. Salaries are highly competitive and tax-free and, depending on your role and seniority, benefits can include family visas, annual flight tickets, medical insurance for you and your dependents, and education allowances for your children. We do not discriminate based on race, colour, nationality, ethnicity, religion, gender, marital status, age, disability, pregnancy or parental status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. review_candidates.title: Compensation & Benefits Manager (Asia)
review_candidates.description: We are looking for an experienced Compensation & Benefits Manager to shape and drive reward strategies across Asia, with a key focus on Singapore and Malaysia. You will play a critical role in ensuring our compensation and benefits programs remain competitive, equitable and aligned with business and talent needs — leveraging market insights, analytics and data to influence reward decisions. This is an opportunity for a commercially minded C&B professional to make a meaningful impact on how we attract, reward and retain talent in a growing global product and manufacturing operations organization. This role can be based in Malaysia, Kuala Lumpur, Shah Alam or Singapore. Responsibilities Compensation Assist in the development, implementation, administration, and evaluation of programs, procedures, policies, and practices designed to provide for equitable and competitive employee compensation and experience. Conduct market benchmarking and salary surveys to ensure competitiveness and alignment with industry trends. Support annual compensation processes including merit increases, promotions, market adjustments, and salary structure reviews. Build trusted relationships with business leaders across Operations, Engineering and supporting functions to deliver people strategies that enable business performance Complete job evaluations on new or reclassified roles, review benchmark market data, make recommendations for salary range and job classification, and update systems post approval. Support the administration of incentive programs, variable bonus plans, retention programs, and recognition initiatives. Support maintaining and updating compensation structures, job families, and salary ranges in Oracle. Benefits Administration Administer and communicate employee benefits programs including medical insurance, life insurance, wellness programs, and leave benefits. Work with insurance broker and benefit providers to manage renewals, claims administration, employee communications, and vendor performance. Conduct periodic reviews of benefits offerings and provide recommendations to improve employee value proposition while managing costs. Support employee inquiries relating to compensation and benefits matters. Analytics and Reporting Provide technical, data preparation and modelling, and analytical support to a variety of compensation programs and tools, including, but not limited to, annual review process, short and long-term incentive plans, and other broad-based compensation and HR programs. Analyze compensation trends, pay equity, turnover, retention, and workforce demographics to support business decision-making. Prepare reports and presentations for senior management, HR leadership, and corporate stakeholders. Compliance and Governance Ensure compensation and benefits programs comply with applicable labour laws, regulations, and company policies across Asia. Support internal and external audits related to compensation and benefits administration. Requirements Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Finance, Accounting, or a related discipline. Minimum 8 years of relevant experience in Compensation & Benefits, Total Rewards, or a related HR function. Regional experience supporting compensation and benefits programs across Singapore and Malaysia; broader Asia experience is preferred. Strong knowledge of compensation principles, salary benchmarking, job evaluation methodologies, and benefits administration. Experience administering variable bonus, incentive, and recognition programs. Strong quantitative, analytical, and problem-solving skills with the ability to interpret data, identify trends, and provide actionable recommendations. Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including pivot tables, lookups, and data analysis. Experience with Power BI preferred. Experience enhancing and/or implementing compensation systems and reporting tools. Experience with Human Capital Management (HCM) System (e.g., Workday, SAP, or Oracle) for data management, extraction, and reporting. Proficiency in Oracle Fusion HCM preferred. Strong attention to detail with excellent organizational and project management skills. Effective communication and stakeholder management skills with the ability to work across all organizational levels. Ability to handle confidential and sensitive information with discretion. Experience partnering with leaders in a semiconductor, high-tech manufacturing or engineering environment is highly preferred. Why Join Ichor? Competitive Rewards & Benefits – AWS, quarterly variable bonus, employee stock purchase plan, medical, dental, optical benefits, and shift allowance where applicable. Be Part of the Semiconductor Industry – Support advanced semiconductor manufacturing through innovative products, precision manufacturing and critical technologies. Learning & Development – Build your skills through hands-on experience, on-the-job learning, training and education upgrading support. Career Opportunities – Take on new challenges and build your career with a global organization that recognises and rewards your contributions. People & Culture – Be part of an inclusive workplace that values innovation, collaboration, operational excellence, honesty, reliability and employee wellbeing.
